test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94b0f6bbebf496d9aaa93b39b092a871a4e987f22a7ce1207965169c6aa9663e.png]
solution:
When we compare both the figures we get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f592784672eac925e1c14b7f8483c7d21c09fe416422a90963224ae9343df3ce.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice upwards towards right such that 2 and 3 are visible we find that on the left we have 1 and on the right we have 4 which means they both are opposite to each other. So, **4 is the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 1.**

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
